raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #41038. For GLM-5.3-Flash DFlash2 with Mooncake PD disaggregation and asymmetric P/D TP (for example, P TP2 to D TP4), the draft KV source and destination have different per-rank layouts. Reusing the source KV item lengths for destination addressing can fail at the tail of a transfer.

## Modifications

- Keep the normal target-KV transfer path.
- Split the DFlash draft-KV transfer into the corresponding destination TP ranks, pack source pages into a registered GPU staging buffer, and pass destination KV item lengths separately.
- Scope the path to DFlash with unequal P/D TP, leaving other speculative algorithms and equal-TP transfers on the existing path.
- Build on the destination-length support in #40045.

## Accuracy Tests

- The original internal prototype completed a 256/256-request short regression that previously completed 228/256. This result is not a GPU validation of this exact community commit.
- `git diff --check` and Python 3.11 `py_compile` passed on the rebased patch.
- Full output-token equivalence and a GPU rerun on current community main are pending. Local pytest collection was not completed because the default Python 3.9 environment cannot parse this repository's Python 3.10+ syntax.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not yet measured on this exact community commit; this PR addresses transfer correctness.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format code with pre-commit
- [ ] Add/run unit tests
- [ ] Update documentation, if needed
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance

nodes.body:
Verified this on main against #41038 — the mechanism is real and the implementation is sound overall. Two small notes and one scope remark.

What's checked: the non-DCP `send_kvcache` does pass `kv_args.kv_item_lens` as both source and destination strides into `_send_kvcache_generic` (the generic call site uses `item_lens[i]` for both ends), so the P TP2 → D TP4 draft-page mismatch is as described. The ownership mapping (`dst_tp_rank // ratio == src_tp_rank` gates the send, `slice_num = dst_tp_rank % ratio` picks the head slice) covers every decode rank exactly once — I enumerated ratio=2 and it partitions cleanly. `RegistrationInfo.dst_tp_rank` / `dst_kv_item_lens` already exist from #40045 and the wiring reuses them as intended; `gather_all_layers_to_staging`'s signature matches main; the `can_pack` guards are conservative in the right ways; the `prefill.py` insertion point has `draft_kv_pool` in scope.

Notes:
1. The branch keys on `self.server_args.speculative_algorithm == "DFLASH"`, an exact match on the raw CLI string. `--speculative-algorithm dflash` is accepted elsewhere (`SpeculativeAlgorithm.from_string` upper-cases), so lowercase input would silently bypass this branch — the same silent-failure class this PR fixes. This follows the existing convention in the arg_groups hooks (several do `== "EAGLE"` / `== "DSPARK"` on the raw string), so it is a tree-wide gap rather than something introduced here; a `.upper()` is still cheap insurance.
2. Skewed-peer edge: if a destination ever sends `dst_kv_item_lens` without `dst_attn_tp_size`, the `!=` guard enters the branch and the `%` raises TypeError instead of the clean RuntimeError the lens check produces for the common skew. `dst_attn_tp_size and dst_attn_tp_size != self.attn_tp_size` would make it uniform. Marginal.

Scope remark (not blocking): the DCP path handles asymmetric draft TP algorithm-agnostically, while this branch is DFLASH-only — a NEXTN/MTP draft over non-DCP asymmetric TP still takes the old path silently. Follow-up material.

Happy to run the P TP2 → D TP4 mooncake validation with a DFlash2 draft once we regain GPU access.

Transfer-level validation of this PR — results first, method and limits below.

We picked up an 8×A800-80GB box for this, but GLM-5.3 e2e is arithmetically impossible on it (NVFP4 ~198 GB needs ~99 GiB/rank at P TP2), so the validation went one level down: synthetic KV pools shaped exactly like GLM-5.3-Flash + DFlash2 (MLA target entries TP-invariant + head-sharded draft entries), RDMA mocked by recording every transfer block and replaying it into a byte-level memory model. Everything under test is the real function body from base `acc15c19` / PR head `8c43def6`. 139 checks, 0 failures:

| scenario | result |
|---|---|
| base, P TP2 → D TP4 | **bug reproduced**: only 7266/2097152 dst draft bytes "correct" (0.35% ≈ random-collision floor); **524,288 bytes exactly OOB** = tail chunk × 65536 B src stride × 4 draft entries, all landing past the dst region — precisely "fails at the tail". Target MLA 20/20 pages unaffected |
| PR fallback path | per-block address math 0 wrong; full numpy replay 40/40 draft pages byte-exact; guard rails raise RuntimeError |
| PR staging path | real CUDA tensors, Triton gather and torch fallback both 40/40 byte-exact |
| PR, lowercase `--speculative-algorithm dflash` | byte-identical misdelivery numbers as base — the case-sensitivity note in my review above, now with data |
| PR, equal TP4→TP4 | same behaviour as base, no raise (no regression) |
| PR, P TP2 → D TP8 (ratio=4) | fallback + staging both byte-exact |

Script, logs, machine-readable JSON: https://github.com/Leslie360/specdraft/tree/main/verification/sglang-41040-asym-tp-transfer

Limits, stated plainly: transport is mocked, the addressing math is not; e2e serving with real Mooncake RDMA and real weights stays open (needs B300-class memory at P TP2, or 12 GPUs); PP>1 untested.

One correction to my review above: the registration dataclass is `KVArgsRegisterInfo` (fields `dst_tp_rank` / `dst_kv_item_lens`) at `python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/mooncake/conn.py:138`, not `RegistrationInfo`.

Thanks @number-eleven11. Closing this because it is still a draft and has not been updated in 25 days.

Reopen it if the work is still relevant.

Some directories moved recently, so an older branch may need retargeting:
`sgl-kernel/` -> `python/sglang/kernels/aot/`, `python/sglang/jit_kernel/`
-> `python/sglang/kernels/jit/`, `docs/` -> `docs/docs/` (`.mdx`),
`bench_serving.py` -> `benchmark/serving.py`, `test/srt/` -> `test/registered/`.

+    def _send_draft_kvcache_tp_slice(

+        session_id: str,
+        src_indices: npt.NDArray[np.int32],
+        dst_indices: npt.NDArray[np.int32],
+        src_ptrs: List[int],
+        dst_ptrs: List[int],
+        src_item_lens: List[int],
+        dst_item_lens: List[int],
+        src_layer_ids: List[int],
+        dst_layer_ids: List[int],
+        dst_tp_rank: Optional[int],
+        dst_tp_size: int,
+    ) -> int:
+        """Head-slice DFlash draft KV for a smaller prefill TP than decode TP."""
+        src_tp_size = self.attn_tp_size
+        if (
+            dst_tp_rank is None
+            or dst_tp_size % src_tp_size
+            or dst_tp_size <= src_tp_size
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("Unsupported asymmetric-TP DFlash draft KV layout")
+        ratio = dst_tp_size // src_tp_size
+        src_tp_rank = self.kv_args.engine_rank % src_tp_size
+        dst_tp_rank %= dst_tp_size
+        if dst_tp_rank // ratio != src_tp_rank:
+            # Another prefill rank owns this decode rank's draft heads.
+            return 0
+        if len(src_indices) != len(dst_indices):
+            raise RuntimeError("DFlash draft source/destination page counts differ")
+        pairs = build_transfer_entry_pairs(
+            src_layer_ids,
+            dst_layer_ids,
+            len(src_ptrs),
+            len(dst_ptrs),
+            allow_positional_fallback=self.pp_size == 1,
+        )
+        page_size = self.kv_args.page_size
+        slice_num = dst_tp_rank % ratio
+        draft_buffers = self._draft_kv_buffers
+        if draft_buffers is not None:
+            k_buffers, v_buffers = draft_buffers
+            half = len(src_ptrs) // 2
+            can_pack = (
+                len(src_ptrs)
+                == len(dst_ptrs)
+                == len(src_item_lens)
+                == len(dst_item_lens)
+                and len(k_buffers) == len(v_buffers) == half
+                and all(
+                    buf.data_ptr() == ptr
+                    for buf, ptr in zip(k_buffers + v_buffers, src_ptrs)
+                )
+                and len(set(src_item_lens)) == len(set(dst_item_lens)) == 1
+                and all(
+                    src_item_lens[i] == dst_item_lens[j] * ratio
+                    for i, j in pairs
+                )
+            )
+            if can_pack:
+                from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.staging_buffer import (
+                    StagingBuffer,
+                    gather_all_layers_to_staging,
+                )
+
+                src_heads = k_buffers[0].shape[1]
+                dst_heads = src_heads // ratio
+                dst_token_bytes = dst_item_lens[0] // page_size
+                can_pack = (
+                    src_heads % ratio == 0
+                    and dst_heads * k_buffers[0].shape[-1]
+                    * k_buffers[0].element_size()
+                    == dst_token_bytes
+                )
+            if can_pack:
+                thread_id = threading.get_ident()
+                required_bytes = 8 * sum(dst_item_lens)
+                pack_buffer = self._draft_pack_buffers.get(thread_id)
+                if pack_buffer is None:
+                    device = f"cuda:{self.kv_args.gpu_id}"
+                    pack_buffer = StagingBuffer(
+                        required_bytes, device, self.kv_args.gpu_id
+                    )
+                    self.engine.batch_register(
+                        [pack_buffer.get_ptr()], [pack_buffer.get_size()]
+                    )
+                    self._draft_pack_buffers[thread_id] = pack_buffer
+                    logger.info(
+                        "DFlash asymmetric-TP draft KV uses packed GPU staging: "
+                        "source TP=%s, destination TP=%s, buffer=%s bytes",
+                        src_tp_size,
+                        dst_tp_size,
+                        required_bytes,
+                    )
+                for start in range(0, len(src_indices), 8):
+                    page_count = min(8, len(src_indices) - start)
+                    written = gather_all_layers_to_staging(
+                        k_buffers,
+                        v_buffers,
+                        src_indices[start : start + page_count],
+                        pack_buffer,
+                        slice_num * dst_heads,
+                        dst_heads,
+                        page_size,
+                        self.kv_args.gpu_id,
+                    )
+                    if written != page_count * sum(dst_item_lens):
+                        raise RuntimeError("DFlash draft KV gather size mismatch")
+                    offsets = [0]
+                    for item_len in dst_item_lens:
+                        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + page_count * item_len)
+                    blocks = [
+                        (
+                            pack_buffer.get_ptr()
+                            + offsets[i]
+                            + page_pos * dst_item_lens[i],
+                            dst_ptrs[j] + int(dst_page) * dst_item_lens[j],
+                            dst_item_lens[j],
+                        )
+                        for i, j in pairs
+                        for page_pos, dst_page in enumerate(
+                            dst_indices[start : start + page_count]
+                        )
+                    ]
+                    ret = self._transfer_data(session_id, blocks)
+                    if ret != 0:
+                        return ret
+                return 0
+        for start in range(0, len(src_indices), 8):
+            blocks = []
+            for i, j in pairs:
+                src_stride = src_item_lens[i]
+                dst_stride = dst_item_lens[j]
+                if src_stride != dst_stride * ratio or dst_stride % page_size:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "Unsupported asymmetric-TP DFlash draft KV stride: "
+                        f"source={src_stride}, destination={dst_stride}, ratio={ratio}"
+                    )
+                src_token_stride = src_stride // page_size
+                dst_token_stride = dst_stride // page_size
+                head_offset = slice_num * dst_token_stride
+                for src_page, dst_page in zip(
+                    src_indices[start : start + 8],

+                        (

+                            dst_token_stride,
+                        )
+                        for token in range(page_size)
+                    )
+            ret = self._transfer_data(session_id, blocks)
+            if ret != 0:
+                return ret
+        return 0
